method: Fetched official Naturvardsverket/Lansstyrelsen Leder WFS features in EPSG:3006 by Led_ID, transformed SWEREF99 TM coordinates to WGS84, assembled multipart state-trail linework, clipped grouped features to researched Kungsleden section anchors, reversed output where needed, preserved non-hiking/transport gaps as MultiLineString breaks, and applied conservative 5 m Douglas-Peucker simplification.
